confirmed_blocking.summary: config_models reads config.json with an unguarded json.loads and unvalidated shape, so a valid-JSON-wrong-shape config crashes ./install.sh with a raw AttributeError traceback (FR-022 guard checks parse only) and an unparseable config crashes render.py --models/--out with a raw JSONDecodeError, breaking the spec quality constraint 'no path raises a traceback at the user' (ENG-17, ENG-25).
confirmed_blocking.evidence: tools/render.py:58 `return json.loads(config.read_text()).get("models", {}).get(name, {})`; install.sh guard (46-58) only runs json.load. Reproduced: config.json '[]' or '{"models": 5}' aborts ./install.sh --harness opencode with AttributeError; '{not json' aborts `render.py opencode --models` with JSONDecodeError. FR-001/FR-003 make this read unconditional; nothing rendered or linked on the install path.
confirmed_blocking.fix: In config_models, validate the parsed document is a dict (root and models/harness entries) and catch (OSError, ValueError) around the read/parse, raising SystemExit naming the config path and the error; cover wrong-shape and unparseable configs with tests.

confirmed_blocking.summary: cmd_rebind performs no ended-status refusal before write_run, so a pr-open or aborted run's stored paths are still rewritten, violating FR-009 and this run's cli-delta.md 'write commands generally' row (ENG-26).
confirmed_blocking.evidence: cmd_rebind resolves via one_run() (858) and writes via write_run (874) with no status check; write_run (401) has none. The refusal exists only in resolve_target (369, 391-396) and cmd_resume (890). The FR-009 test covers only pending selection.
confirmed_blocking.fix: After one_run() in cmd_rebind, refuse status pr-open/aborted with die(1, ...) naming the status; add a test asserting the ended run's state is unchanged.

advisory.summary: ENG-26: a fresh successful checkpoint stamps the SHA only when the entry was reused, so a first-time success records commit: null, indistinguishable from a failed commit.
advisory.fix: Stamp the trailing history entry with the landed SHA on every successful commit.

advisory.summary: ENG-7: dead fallback `or started`; now_utc() is always truthy.
advisory.fix: Drop `or started` or make the fallback explicit.

advisory.summary: ENG-7: the FR-011 reuse heuristic collapses consecutive same-stage checkpoints whenever commit is None (always on pending runs).
advisory.fix: Narrow reuse to the commit-failure retry case (e.g. previous entry's commit_error) or worktree runs; add a test.
